# PSoup

The goal of PSoup is to enable users to quickly generate mathematical
descriptions of complex systems, which can be used to run simulations.
PSoup reads diagrammatic representations of biological systems
(specifically of type SBGN), and uses algebraic rules to transform the
diagram into a set of difference equations. PSoup provides support to
enable the running of simulations, as well as analysing the resulting
output.

To build a diagram of type SBGN, go to [Newt Pathway Viewer &
Editor](https://newteditor.org/).

To see a series of tutorials on how to use PSoup, go to
[nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/).

## Installation

You can install PSoup from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("NicoleZFortuna/PSoup")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Genotype-class`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/Genotype-class.md)
  [`Genotype`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/Genotype-class.md)
  : A function to generate objects of class 'Genotype'
- [`Hormone-class`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/Hormone-class.md)
  [`Hormone`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/Hormone-class.md)
  : A function to generate objects of class 'Hormone'
- [`Network-class`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/Network-class.md)
  [`Network`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/Network-class.md)
  : A function to generate objects of class 'Network'
- [`altSourceToStimulant()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/altSourceToStimulant.md)
  : A function to convert altSource inputs to stimulants.
- [`buildHormone()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/buildHormone.md)
  : A function to build a hormone object
- [`buildModel()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/buildModel.md)
  : A function to generate equations from a network object
- [`buildNetwork()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/buildNetwork.md)
  : A function for building a network object
- [`consistencyCheck()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/consistencyCheck.md)
  : A function to check the internal consistency of a Network object.
- [`convertSBGNdiagram()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/convertSBGNdiagram.md)
  : A function that converts an SBGN-ML text file into a network object
- [`coregulators()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/coregulators.md)
  : A function that creates a string with coregulators multiplied
  together
- [`differenceString()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/differenceString.md)
  : A function to build the difference equation including delays
- [`exogenousScreen()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/exogenousScreen.md)
  : A function to generate all combinations of two vectors containing
  the values to be screened for two nodes. This function will also
  include the possibility of no exogenous values being provided in the
  form of NA.
- [`exploreEdges()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/exploreEdges.md)
  : A function to test how network behavior changes in response to
  changing the nature of edge types.
- [`fastPlot()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/fastPlot.md)
  : A plot to quickly inspect the progression of a simulation.
- [`finalStates()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/finalStates.md)
  : A function to pull the final states from a set of simulations.
- [`generateC()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/generateC.md)
  : A function to generate a C script which will execute a simulation of
  the network given a starting condition.
- [`generateEdgeList()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/generateEdgeList.md)
  : A function to generate a data frame which lists all of the edges of
  a network.
- [`generateEquation()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/generateEquation.md)
  : A function to generate an equation for a specific node
- [`generateGeneToNodeList()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/generateGeneToNodeList.md)
  : a function to map the genes that effect nodes in a network
- [`genotypeScreen()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/genotypeScreen.md)
  : A function to generate genotype screens.
- [`getExampleDiagram()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/getExampleDiagram.md)
  : a function to move the example .sbgn file into a folder of the users
  choice.
- [`getSubmapNodes()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/getSubmapNodes.md)
  : A function to pull out information from with in submaps
- [`langConversion`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/langConversion.md)
  : A data.frame containing the language conventions and their
  equivalence of the PSoup package, and the SBGN languages 'activity
  flow' and 'entity relationship'.
- [`languageConversion()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/languageConversion.md)
  : A function to convert SBGN language to PSoup language
- [`listGenotypes()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/listGenotypes.md)
  : A function to list all objects of class genotype in the current
  environment
- [`listNodes()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/listNodes.md)
  : A function to list all objects of class hormone in the current
  environment
- [`modifierPriorScreen()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/modifierPriorScreen.md)
  : A function to generate a screen of modifier conditions based on a
  set of prior distributions.
- [`numCombn()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/numCombn.md)
  : A function to calculate the number of unique combinations of a
  vector of length n of sample size r.
- [`peaNetwork`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/peaNetwork.md)
  : Definition for the peaNetwork object.
- [`plot(`*`<simData>`*`)`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/plot.simData.md)
  : A function to comparatively plot the outcomes of different
  simulations
- [`print.Network`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/print.Network.md)
  : This is a function which specifies the print method for objects of
  class Network.
- [`randomStartScreen()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/randomStartScreen.md)
  : A function to generate a number of random starting point
  reassignments.
- [`reportCondition()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/reportCondition.md)
  : A function to report any deviation from the baseline for simulations
- [`restoreBaseModel()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/restoreBaseModel.md)
  : A function to restore the base model.
- [`setupSims()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/setupSims.md)
  : A wrapper function that allows you to run simulations of a network
  under many different conditions.
- [`simulateNetwork()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/simulateNetwork.md)
  : A function to simulate a network
- [`stabilityVector()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/stabilityVector.md)
  : A function to create a vector that reports whether simulations have
  managed to reach stability by the maximum timestep.
- [`tidyScreen()`](https://nicolezfortuna.github.io/PSoup/reference/tidyScreen.md)
  : A function to make sure that data.frames containing conditions to
  screen are organised correctly. The wild-type condition is made to
  come first, and any duplicate rows are removed.
